strategy: London EMA trend pullback, VIX-band target

params.costs: $1.90 a micro round trip + 1 tick on market fills

rules: Market: NQ / MNQ futures, 5-minute chart. Entries 03:00-09:30 ET, not on Mondays, max 1 trade a day, flat 15:55.
Trend: on the 15-minute AND the 1-hour chart the EMA 21 is above the EMA 50 (longs; below for shorts). Only closed bars.
Pullback: a run of down candles (for a long) that reaches the 5-minute EMA 50 (low within 0.1 ATR of it).
Sweep (VIX version): the pullback low takes out an earlier confirmed 5-minute swing low (stop hunt), by less than 1.5 ATR.
Trigger: a 5-minute candle closes above the open of the first candle of that down run (CISD, as LIT). Enter at the next 5-minute open.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the pullback low (the sweep wick). Stops under 6 or over 80 points: no trade. Size follows the stop.
Target (VIX version): the 18:00 open + 1 VIX one-day move (VIX prior close / 100 / sqrt(252) x open), at least 1.5R (else no trade), banked at 8R. 3R version: 3 x the stop distance.
Breakeven: at +1R the stop moves to entry + 1.25 points (covers costs). No other management.

Size: $500 risk a trade (micros = 500 / (stop x $2), 1-40). Eval: the same capped at 60% of the room to the trailing max loss and the $1,000 soft daily loss. On the LIT account: LIT first, no EMA entry while a LIT trade is open.
